metadata.description: Nohjen's marketplace of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: An end-to-end feature workflow as a single plugin: brainstorm options on a page you answer in place, write a medium-weight spec, audit umbrellas for coherence, implement the spec (solo, via a team of agents, or as a scripted dynamic workflow), then document what shipped. Five sibling skills (feature-brainstorm, feature-spec, feature-spec-audit, feature-implement, doc-generator) that share conventions and reference assets.
